title: Grateful Dead Live at Philadelphia Civic Center on 1984-04-21
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1) > Korg MR-1000 (1-bit/5.6MHz) > Audiogate (1-bit/5.6MHz > 16-bit/44.1KHz) > cdwav (edits)
source: Nakamichi CM-300 (CP-1) x2 > Cassette Master (Sony TCD5M/Maxell UDXLI C-90); Recorded on lower balcony Row J, Seats 5 & 6.

ai_review.summary: Raw, exploratory ’84 performance with a smoking Help > Slipknot! sequence and standout Wharf Rat, captured on an uncharacterized but listenable source.
ai_review.review: The show is praised for its adventurous vibe – the band roams freely, highlighted by a fiery Help > Slipknot! jam and a memorable Wharf Rat. While reviewers don’t comment on the technical side of the recording, they note the atmosphere and Jerry’s playing as key positives, making it worth a spin despite the lack of detailed sound quality information.

ai_rating.rationale: Three reviews lean toward 4‑star enthusiasm about the performance with no major complaints; recording quality is unknown but not flagged as a problem, yielding a solid above‑average rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No reviewers mention soundboard or audience details; audio appears acceptable enough for listening, with no noted flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The concert is described as raw and exploratory, with the band chasing improvisational directions rather than a tight rock set; transitions feel adventurous.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his adventurous guitar work and central role in the Help > Slipknot! jam.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboards) noted for taking a divergent improvisational direction alongside Jerry.
